_meta.note: Korean overlays for MINOC.TLK. Keys under each npc are classic English (en_u4) as fixed by TalkTlk after load; ko holds translations. topicN / topicN_aliases are short nouns only (no particles, no verb stems) so interest input and BBCode highlights stay stable. Dialogue lines prefer those same nouns in running text when the topic is meant to read as a keyword.

npcs.name: Julia
npcs.response1:
Self
preservation is
the first law of
nature; self
sacrifice the
highest rule
of grace.
npcs.response2:
Within this
house are many
poor and
destitute souls.
npcs.question: Wilt thou help?

ko.name: 줄리아
ko.response1:
자기 보존은
자연의 첫 법칙이고,
자기 희생은
은총의 가장 높은
계율입니다.
ko.response2:
이 집 안에는
가난과 곤궁에
처한 영혼들이
많아요.
ko.question: 도움을 주시겠습니까?

npcs.name: Zircon
npcs.response2:
Ah, yes, the
mystic weapons,
and armour, my
greatest work!
Those I gave
unto Sir Simon
and Lady Tessa.
npcs.question:
Seek thee
a weapon?

ko.name: 지르콘
ko.response2:
아, 그래요.
신비의 무기와
갑옷, 내 최고의 작품!
사이먼 경과
테사 부인에게
드렸지요.
ko.question: 무기가 필요하신가요?

npcs.name: Bob the Beggar
npcs.health:
I am very sick,
help me!
npcs.response1:
I need money
to cure my
sickness.
npcs.question:
Hast thou
any money?
npcs.yes:
Then please
share it
with me!
npcs.no:
Then join me and
we can beg
together!

npcs.name: Linda Sue
npcs.response1:
I have not eaten
in days.
npcs.response2:
Oh, thou art
a kind soul!
npcs.question:
Could thou spare
a nibble of
food?

npcs.name: Gimble
npcs.response1:
I suffer from a
tsetse byte!
npcs.question:
Could thou spare
a gold piece so
I may buy a
last drink?
npcs.yes:
Remember Azure
knows of the
rune!

ko.name: 김블
ko.response1:
체체 파리에
물린 뒤 앓고 있어요!
ko.question:
마지막 술 한 잔을
살 금화 하나
나눌 수 있나요?
ko.yes:
기억하세요.
애저가 룬에 대해
알고 있습니다!

npcs.name: Jude
npcs.response1:
I will not speak
of my sin!
npcs.question:
If I help thee
wilt thou swear
to only use it
at the mouth of
the abyss to
destroy it?
npcs.yes:
It can be found
at lat-P'F"
long-M'F" on the
darkest night!

ko.name: 주드
ko.question:
내가 돕는다면,
오직 심연의 입구에서
그것을 파괴하는 데만
쓰겠다고 맹세하겠소?
ko.yes:
가장 어두운 밤에
위도 P'F",
경도 M'F"에서
찾을 수 있소!

npcs.name: Alkerion
npcs.job:
I am a peasant,
I hear many
things.
npcs.response1:
What does thou
wish to know?
npcs.response2:
The stone of
sacrifice is
orange in color
and used in the
altar rooms of
love and
courage!
npcs.question: Seeketh thou?

ko.name: 알케리온
ko.job:
나는 농부요.
소문을 많이
알고 있소.
ko.response2:
희생의 돌은
주황색이며
사랑과 용기의
제단 방에서
쓰입니다!
ko.question: 찾는 것이 있소?

npcs.name: Mike Ward
npcs.job:
I am trying to
get a room.
npcs.response1:
I have travelled
clear from
Skara Brae.
npcs.response2:
The rune of our
city is missing!
npcs.question:
Know thee
of the rune?
npcs.yes:
It is the key to
the shrine of
spirituality!
npcs.no:
It is not in
Skara Brae.

npcs.name: Alex
npcs.job:
I give out
flowers. Here
you are!
npcs.response1:
The way I figure
it, if thou art
kind to others
they will have
reason to be
kind in return!
npcs.response2:
Yes, give all
that thou can
unto the needy!
npcs.question: Wilt thou give?

ko.name: 알렉스
ko.response1:
제 생각엔,
남에게 친절을
베풀면 그들도
친절로 답할
이유가 생기지요!
ko.response2:
네, 가능한 한
필요한 이에게
모두 주세요!
ko.question: 주시겠어요?

npcs.name: Shentis
npcs.job:
I welcome thee
unto Minoc, city
of sacrifice!
npcs.question:
Dost thou strive
for virtue?
npcs.yes:
Then perhaps
thou shalt
become an
avatar!

ko.name: 셴티스
ko.job:
희생의 도시
미녹에 오신 걸
환영합니다!
ko.question:
미덕을 위해
힘쓰십니까?

npcs.name: Singsong
npcs.response2:
Very well,
the raven sings,
the raven saw
and in the corn
he sayeth 'CAH'.
npcs.question:
Dost thou
like it?

ko.name: 싱송
ko.response2:
좋아요.
까마귀의 노래,
까마귀가 보고,
옥수수밭에서
'카아' 한대요.
ko.question: 마음에 드시나요?

npcs.name: Damon
npcs.response2:
Listen to the
bard's song for
in its verse
lies the key!
npcs.question:
Can't a man
just think
to himself?
npcs.no:
Oh, yes
I can thou
bandersnatch!

ko.name: 데이먼
ko.response2:
음유시인의 노래를
들으시오. 가사 안에
만트라의 열쇠가
있소!
ko.question:
혼자만의 생각은
안 되는 거요?
ko.no:
아, 물론 할 수
있지. 이 잔소리꾼이!

npcs.name: Mischief
npcs.response2:
The rune of
sacrifice is
hard to get. It
lies within the
fires of the
forge!
npcs.question:
Hast thou
the rune?
npcs.yes:
Then ask
Alkerion of the
stone!
npcs.no:
Return when thou
dost find it!

ko.name: 미시프
ko.response2:
희생의 룬은
얻기 어렵지요.
대장간 불꽃
속에 있어요!
ko.question: 룬이 있으신가요?

npcs.name: Azure
npcs.response1:
I carve runes
for passage into
the shrines!
npcs.question:
Dost thou
seek a rune?

ko.name: 애저
ko.response1:
신전 통과용
룬 조각이
제 손에서 나옵니다!
ko.response2:
여동생 미시프에게
물어보세요.
희생의 룬 말이죠.
ko.question: 룬을 찾으시나요?

npcs.name: Merida
npcs.job:
I seek the
wisdom of the
shrine of
sacrifice.
npcs.response1:
But first I need
the mantra!
npcs.response2:
I am told that a
hidden shepherd
knows the
mantra.
npcs.question:
Know ye
the mantra?
npcs.no:
The shrine is on
a lake to the
east!

npcs.name: a guard
npcs.response1:
I often wonder
if I will ever
have to give my
life in the line
of duty.
npcs.question:
Understand
my dilemma?
npcs.yes:
Of course, if it
came down to it,
I hope I would
do it!

ko.name: 경비병
ko.response1:
임무 중 생명을
바쳐야 할 날이
올까, 자주
생각합니다.
ko.question:
내 고민을
이해하시오?
ko.yes:
물론, 그런 순간이
온다면 그러길
바라오!
